what: Al I 1D non-LTE abundance corrections (delta_nlte = A_NLTE - A_LTE) for the subordinate doublet 6696.023 / 6698.673, derived by synthesising NLTE vs LTE in PySME from the Amarsi-2020 departure grid (pipeline/pysme_nlte.py). Family-B element (Option 2, PySME).
model_atom: Nordlander & Lind 2017 (A&A 607, A75) Al I model atom, as used in the Amarsi et al. 2020 (A&A 642, A62) GALAH departure grid (Zenodo v3, record 3982506).
derivation: PySME 1.0.1 + SME backend 6.13, MARCS marcs2012 grid. delta = A_used - A* where EW_LTE(A*) = EW_NLTE (NLTE strengthens these lines slightly -> small negative correction).

validation.anchor: Nordlander & Lind 2017: subordinate Al I solar corrections are near-zero to <= -0.04 dex on the lower MS.
validation.result: solar (5772/4.44/0.0): 6696 -0.027, 6698 -0.017, median -0.022 -> PASS (within the published small-negative band). Reproduced, not fitted.
validation.lte_baseline_portability: PySME-LTE vs iSpec/MOOG(TS)-LTE A(Al) from a common EW: eps = -0.011 dex (< 0.02) -> delta is cleanly portable onto the TS/EW pipeline baseline; no baseline correction needed (RYA-402 sub-flag cleared for Family B).

grid.schema: element, ion, wave_A, teff_K, logg, feh, delta_nlte
grid.nodes: 9 (Teff 5300-6200, logg 4.0-4.7, [Fe/H] -0.3..+0.3) spanning the FGK-dwarf range incl. solar + 55 Cnc; LinearND-interpolated per wave by the registry.
grid.trend: more negative at cooler Teff, less at hotter — consistent with Nordlander & Lind 2017.

registered: config.constants.NLTE_CORRECTION_ELEMENTS['Al'] (flag NLTE_Amarsi2020_PySME_1D); Beast YAML physics_regime_rya400.yaml Al verdict flipped GET-GRID -> LOCKED.
